faq: Can the app look different on iOS and Android?
Yes. We can use one shared design, or adapt small parts such as navigation, switches and dialogs to each platform's habits. We recommend what suits your audience and show both in the mockups.
Do my users need to do anything?
No. They get the new look through a normal store update, with accounts and saved data intact. We test the upgrade from your live version before handover.
Do you need my source code?
Yes, since the screens are rebuilt in your Flutter project. Send a repository invite. If you only have the compiled app, a redesign needs a rebuild, which we can quote separately.
Can you use our brand guidelines?
Yes. Send logos, colors, fonts and any guideline document. We turn them into a Flutter theme so the same brand shows up on every screen and on both platforms.
